title: Where is your brother? Apothecaries’ hall. My whetstone.
html_source:
Likely Joyce as Stephen referencing Joyce’s brother Stanislaus.

Stanislaus worked as a clerk at the Apothecaries' Hall.

http://www.ricorso.net/rx/library/criticism/major/Joyce_JA/Ellmann_R3.htm

Stanislaus seemingly has no analog in Ulysses, though he appeared as Maurice in Stephen Hero.
